summary: Mobile-only frontend testing of Wayly mobile parity screens on Expo web preview (390x844). 7/8 features PASS as cathy@example.com (Settings hub nav, Profile edit incl. email-change form, Family Members incl. empty-email validation + real invite success/pending, Weekly Digest preview+history, Security incl. password reset + 2FA setup renders QR+verify input, Usage cards render, Danger Zone confirm gate correctly toggles disabled/enabled, Plan Select shows solo+family with CURRENT badge on family and subscribe-solo button — family shows 'current plan' row instead of subscribe as expected). CRITICAL BUG: Onboarding wizard (/onboarding) crashes with 'useDrawer must be used within DrawerProvider' error boundary because `WaylyHeader` uses `useDrawer()` but `DrawerProvider` is only mounted inside `app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx`. Signup + onboarding entry path is 100% broken for new users — feature (H) is DEAD.

ui_bugs.issue: Screen throws 'useDrawer must be used within DrawerProvider'. WaylyHeader calls useDrawer() but DrawerProvider is only wrapped inside app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx (lines 28/81). Onboarding is the only out-of-tabs screen using WaylyHeader — all sibling out-of-tabs screens (profile-edit, family-members, weekly-digest, security, usage, danger-zone, plan-select, plan-billing, signup) use AppHeader instead. Reference: /app/mobile/app/onboarding.tsx:7,150 and /app/mobile/src/components/WaylyHeader.tsx:17.

integration_issues.issue: After signup, the app tries to route to /onboarding but the screen instantly crashes with a red LogBox error boundary. New users cannot complete Step 1 → Step 4, cannot create household/participant, and are blocked from reaching /(tabs) dashboard. Feature (H) mobile onboarding wizard is fully blocked.

react_native_issues.issue: DrawerProvider wraps only the tabs group but WaylyHeader (which needs it) is imported by an out-of-tabs route. Reference: /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:28 and /app/mobile/app/onboarding.tsx:150.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix onboarding crash. Recommended: swap `<WaylyHeader />` in /app/mobile/app/onboarding.tsx for `<AppHeader title="Welcome to Wayly" subtitle="Let’s set up the participant profile" />` (matching pattern used by profile-edit, security, plan-select, etc.). Alternative: move `<DrawerProvider>` up into `/app/mobile/app/_layout.tsx` so it wraps every route, or make `useDrawer()` no-op when no provider is present (return `openDrawer: () => {}`). Re-test the full signup → onboarding steps 1–4 → /(tabs) flow after the fix.

Re-run onboarding wizard end-to-end after fix to verify POST /participants with authorisation_confirmed=true persists, PATCH /participants/{id} on step 3 (or skip works), and router.replace('/(tabs)') lands on the dashboard with household_id set.
critical_code_review_comments: Header context leakage: WaylyHeader silently requires DrawerProvider — consider making it defensive (optional chaining or default context value) to avoid crashing when reused outside tabs.
app/onboarding.tsx uses WaylyHeader which is a tab-only header; onboarding shouldn't show the drawer/nav — an AppHeader is the correct fit and matches every other pre-tabs screen (signup/login etc.).

Do NOT delete cathy's account; do NOT complete Stripe checkout when tapping plan-subscribe-solo (it will redirect via Linking.openURL to Stripe).
rca of the issue: Root cause: `/app/mobile/app/onboarding.tsx` renders `<WaylyHeader />` (line 150). `WaylyHeader` calls `useDrawer()` which throws when there is no ancestor `<DrawerProvider>` (see /app/mobile/src/context/DrawerContext.tsx:15). `DrawerProvider` is only wrapped inside `app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx` (line 28), NOT in the root `app/_layout.tsx`. Since `/onboarding` is a route OUTSIDE the (tabs) group (household-gated users are routed to it BEFORE they can enter tabs), the provider is missing and the entire onboarding screen mounts inside an error boundary. Repro: sign up with any fresh email at mobile Expo preview → immediately see a red 'Uncaught Error: useDrawer must be used within DrawerProvider' overlay; no way to complete onboarding. Mitigation: replace WaylyHeader with AppHeader on onboarding.tsx (1-line change matching sibling out-of-tabs screens), OR lift DrawerProvider into root _layout.tsx above ThemedStack.
